title: Microsoft Purview DLP: test files against one or all classifiers (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing test and role-group controls are supported. It should qualify the assertion that the new test uploads files, since Microsoft documents that mechanism only for the existing per-type test, and narrow the checklist's reference to Entra role management.

claims.claim: The same SIT can produce different results in Exchange email, SharePoint and OneDrive files, and Endpoint DLP.
claims.quote: The same sensitive information type can produce different results depending on where content is evaluated—for example, email in transit (Exchange), files at rest (SharePoint and OneDrive), and files on managed devices (Endpoint DLP).

claims.claim: No billing meter is published for the new classifier file test.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview classifier file test licensing pricing meter data classification service description'. Read /purview/purview-billing-models and classifiers overview; the documented classification meter is for scans of stored SharePoint/OneDrive data, not this file test.

claims.claim: The Learn Classifiers overview names no licence.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview data classification licensing Classifiers sensitive information types Microsoft 365 service description'. Read /purview/data-classification-overview in full; it contains classification capabilities and permissions but no licence requirement.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not document which roles can run the new classifier file test.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview Classifiers file testing all classifiers upload file roles default availability tenant setting'. Read /purview/data-classification-overview, /purview/sit-test-a-sit and /purview/purview-permissions; access and per-type roles are documented, but not new file-test permissions.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant setting on the admin UI or automation surfaces to enable or disable this classifier file test.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview file test all classifiers disable tenant PowerShell Security Compliance Test-DataClassification setting'; '"Purview" "test" "all classifiers" upload'. Read classifiers overview, SIT test and Test-DataClassification; no new-test switch, limits or destructive actions found.

claims.claim: Testing with the new feature means uploading a file to the portal.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "test" "all classifiers" upload'; 'Microsoft Purview Classifiers file testing all classifiers upload file roles default availability tenant setting'. Read classifiers overview and SIT test; only the existing test documents upload.
claims.fix: Replace 'Testing means uploading a file to the portal.' with 'The existing per-type test uploads a file to the portal.' The latter is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/sit-test-a-sit.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet

claims.quote: Checklist: 'Check who holds the Entra roles and Purview role groups ... using the role-group row'. Table: 'Who can reach the Classifiers page (Purview role-group membership)'; its path and cmdlet manage Purview role groups, not Entra roles.
claims.fix: Replace the first Before rollout bullet with 'Check who holds the Purview role groups that open the Classifiers page, using the role-group row in the controls table, and remove access testers do not need.'
